def longest_common_subsequence(s1, s2, virus):
    def is_valid_subsequence(subseq, virus):
        return virus not in subseq

    def lcs_with_virus_check(s1, s2, virus):
        m, n = len(s1), len(s2)
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        best_subseq = ""

        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if s1[i - 1] == s2[j - 1]:
                    new_subseq = best_subseq[:dp[i - 1][j - 1]] + s1[i - 1]
                    if is_valid_subsequence(new_subseq, virus):
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
                        best_subseq = new_subseq
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])

        return best_subseq

    result = lcs_with_virus_check(s1, s2, virus)
    return result if result else "0"
